sources.entry: ProtoPie - Create the most advanced prototypes as easy as Pie.

summary.name: ProtoPie
summary.one_liner: ProtoPie is an AI-driven high-fidelity prototyping platform for designing interactions, motion, and device-based UX, with specs for developer handoff.
use_cases: testing prototypes on mobile, tablet and in-car
validating form inputs in a prototype
designing motion and animation for product teams
handing off interaction specs to developers
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ProtoPie as AI-driven prototyping software where AI generates interactions that designers can refine and hand off as specs. It supports dynamic interactions using logic, variables, and formulas, such as validating email addresses and animating objects. Listed features include multi- and cross-device interactions, native device sensors, voice interactions, flexible integrations with real data, and an MCP option. The page also includes a comparison claiming it is the top choice for high-fidelity prototyping against Framer, Adobe XD, Proto.io, and Figma, citing a 2022 design tool survey.
notable: AI-generated interactions that can be refined and handed off as specs
Logic, variables and formulas for dynamic interactions
Multi-device, native sensor and voice interaction support
Realistic automotive UX and HMI simulations
caveats: The page says 'credit-free' for AI refinement, which implies AI usage may otherwise rely on credits; details not given
The page claims a 100% free tier but does not detail limits of paid plans
Platforms beyond web are not named on the page; the macOS listing comes from the awesome-mac list, not the page
